application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description: 1638 Platanus x hispanica (London Plane) - Reduce the crown height by 3m, with lateral reductions of 3m to the east and south and 1.5m to the west, to reduce mechanical loading and the likelihood of branch failure associated with over-extended laterals. 1639 Platanus x hispanica (London Plane) - Reduce lower crown to the south to allow 2.5m clearance under street light. 1643 Platanus x hispanica (London Plane) - Reduce the crown height by 4m and lateral spread by 4m to the east, and by 2.5m to the west, to reduce mechanical loading and the likelihood of branch failure associated with over-extended laterals. 1645 Platanus x hispanica (London Plane) - Prune lower crown to the north to allow 2m clearance from temporary buildings. 1647 Platanus x hispanica (London Plane) - Reduce the crown height by 3m and lateral spread by 3m to the west , to reduce mechanical loading and the likelihood of branch failure associated with over-extended laterals, and historic pruning points. Including the removal of the limb with topside decay at 8m projecting north. 1649 Platanus x hispanica (London Plane) - Reduce the crown height by 3m and lateral spread by 2.5m to the east and south, and by 1.5m to the north and west due to basal decay. 1651 Platanus x hispanica (London Plane) - Overall crown reduction by up to 3m to the previous pruning points to reduce the likelihood of failure due to the discovered decay within the main stem at 8m. 2660 Platanus x hispanica (London Plane) - Reduce the crown height by approximately 2m, with a lateral reduction of approximately 2.5m to the north, south, and west, and 1m to the east, to reduce mechanical loading and the likelihood of branch failure associated with over-extended laterals, proliferated regrowth, and historic pruning points. 2662 Platanus x hispanica (London Plane) - Reduce main lateral limb at 8m projecting to the south-west by 3.5m to reduce the likelihood of failure.
